decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is core to the firm's strategy of binding mobile communication and trusted second-channel interaction, so this option stays valuable at low carrying cost even though there is no evidence after 2019.
It was promoted to a dedicated page in 2019, which signals rising commitment, and the security architecture underpins the whole product family, so dropping it would release little.

The hardware token got its own page in 2019, but hardware carries higher costs and app-based authentication is displacing it, so the option is uncertain yet still worth holding for regulated customers who need hardware.

A payment network compliance suite sits outside the firm's identity-centred direction, was only ever mentioned on the website, and needs costly upkeep as standards change, so the resources likely serve the firm's many other options better.
